title: Product name, short
_comment: sequence runs top to bottom; build-keynote.py turns it into a cut that meets docs/quality-bar.md. Cards: kind hero (title + subtitle), section (one title) or end (last item: logo, title, tagline timed to its voiceover, brand sweep, logo outro). accent = the one key word of the title. Scenes point at raw/<stem>-t<take>.mp4; trim = [inSec, outSec] of the raw take; speed > 1 speeds it up. crop = [x, y, w, h] in source px around the UI that matters (widened to 1.95:1). Times in callouts, zooms and highlights are seconds into the scene after trim and speed; focus and rect are source px (rects from recordings/scout/<stem>.json). voiceover starts voice.lead_in (0.3 s) into its item and must finish before the next voiced item. Music: an instrumental bed from the ElevenLabs MCP compose_music or your own licensed track (scripts/make-bed.py is a timing placeholder only).
